delete.title: Delete {{domain}}?
delete.content: The Caddyfile will be regenerated and Caddy reloaded.

editor.domainPattern: Must be a valid domain (e.g. app.example.com) or a loopback address (localhost, 127.0.0.1)
editor.serviceRequired: Pick a service to route to
editor.serviceExtra: Service in {{name}}'s compose stack. The site will proxy to that container's exposed port.
editor.upstreamExtraApp: Upstream auto-resolved from the app's current container.
editor.upstreamExtraAppService: Resolved as nanoku-{{app}}-{{service}}-1:<port> from {{app}}'s compose stack.
editor.upstreamExtraFree: host:port, URL, or docker container name
editor.schemeExtra: https uses Caddy's automatic HTTPS (default); http forces :80 and skips cert issuance.
